omitted_tabs.reason: SQL privileges are granted per database (user permissions), not per table

gaps.concept: Changing an existing column (type, NOT NULL, default)
gaps.reason: immudb 1.11.0 accepts ALTER COLUMN and does not keep it (embedded/sql/stmt.go:1179; live 2026-10-31); add a new column instead

gaps.concept: Adding a check to an existing table
gaps.reason: immudb has no ADD CONSTRAINT; checks are set at create and can be dropped
Accepted by 1.11.0 and neither stored nor enforced (live: a row referencing a missing parent went in)
No statement; create a new table

fields.label: Table name
fields.help: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores: immudb folds names to lowercase. Renaming is RENAME TO.

fields.label: Columns
fields.help: After create, a column can be added, renamed or dropped; its type, length, NOT NULL, default and auto-increment are fixed (immudb 1.11.0 does not keep ALTER COLUMN). A column a check uses cannot be renamed or dropped until the check is dropped: immudb keeps the check text, and every insert would fail.

columns.label: Default
columns.help: An expression, e.g. 'none', 1.5 or NOW(); read back from the catalog log

columns.label: Auto-increment
columns.help: On the primary key column, at create

fields.label: Primary key
fields.help: Every immudb table has one; it cannot change after create.

fields.label: Checks
fields.help: Enforced on every insert and update, and, unlike standard SQL, a check fails on NULL: write p IS NULL OR p >= 0 to allow a nullable column. Set at create; afterwards a check can only be dropped (no ADD CONSTRAINT). An unnamed check is named <table>_check<n>. Read back from the catalog log.

fields.label: Defaults and checks not read
fields.help: Why the catalog log could not be read; while unread, checks cannot be changed and columns cannot be renamed or dropped here.

notes: Hand-written for providers/immudb/tables.py, which sends every statement through the native /db/sqlexec endpoint as one transaction: over the PostgreSQL wire immudb 1.11.0 reports ALTER TABLE ... ADD as done and does nothing, and drops a check name. Types, lengths, nullability, auto-increment and the key come from COLUMNS() and INDEXES(); defaults and checks from the catalog log (providers/immudb/catalog_log.py, native TxScan), which no catalog query returns. Indexes are their own kind (index.form.json). Round trip verified live on immudb 1.11.0 by tools/tests/test_ui_descriptor_roundtrip_immudb.py (2026-10-31): create with every type, defaults and named and unnamed checks; reopen with no changes; refused rename of a column a check reads; drop a check, rename a column, add and drop columns and rename the table in one batch; refused column change and added check; drop.
